about_the_game:
Havenhold Deluxe Edition includes:

• 90 days of membership time

• Exclusive Skin: Scarlet Crane

※ This product does not include the base game. Players who already own the Standard Edition of Havenhold will receive the above deluxe rewards after purchasing this upgrade pack.

※ The 90 days of membership time will be automatically added to your account upon entering the game — no manual claim required.

※ To obtain the Exclusive Skin: Scarlet Crane, complete the basic tutorial, then press F8 to open the Event Interface. Select Gift Rewards → Deluxe Edition Outfit Pack to claim it.

※ All contents of this product are already included in the Havenhold Deluxe Edition. Please avoid duplicate purchases.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 @ 3.1 GHz or AMD FX-6300 @ 3.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD R9 270 (2GB VRA with Shader Model 5.0 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 Super or Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
